name: conduit-api-tests
description: Automated API tests for Conduit using Postman and Newman

scripts.test:local: for file in tests/collections/*.json; do newman run "$file" -e tests/environments/test.postman_environment.json || exit 1; done
scripts.test:report: for file in tests/collections/*.json; do name=$(basename "$file" .json); newman run "$file" -e tests/environments/test.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export "./reports/${name}-report.html" || exit 1; done
